Request a demo for your firm View the case
Why

Labour exploitation is hard to prove.

No paperwork
Sometimes there is no contract and wages are paid in cash.
Total dependence
The employer is also the landlord and arranges the transport.
Evidence disappears
Loose photos and chat messages with no provable origin are easy to challenge.
The solution in practice

Collecting evidence without drawing attention.

Prologg works in the browser of a phone. There is nothing to install, no account needed and no name.

1

Capture

Capture it in the moment.

The worker records what is happening: photos, audio, locations and documents.

2

Seal

Every file gets a fingerprint.

Every file immediately gets a SHA-256 fingerprint and is stored encrypted.

3

Hand over

The worker decides when the case file goes to you.

The worker decides when and to whom. You receive the case file through a secure environment.

Open source foundation

Audited

Built on GlobaLeaks: the proven open source standard for confidential and cryptographically secured data transfer, independently audited.

What it gives you

A case file you can verify yourself

Stronger from the start
Evidence captured during the exploitation, not afterwards
Verify it yourself
Open standards
Less legwork
Material arrives chronologically, with time and place
Safe for your client
Nothing to install, no account, no name
Prologg can't look inside
Only the worker and you can read the content
